messages.text: Did you get your train sorted for Paris? Entries close for the club coach tonight
Just booked it — going out Sunday morning, back Tuesday evening. Skipping the coach
Sensible. That coach leaves at 4am and smells of embrocation
Exactly. I'll be at registration Sunday afternoon, find me there
Race week! How's the shoulder holding up?
Fine as long as I don't sprint the swim. Wave 3 for me, what did you get?
Wave 2, so I'll be watching you come out of the water. Bring a spare tube, the course has form
Are you free to talk tomorrow evening? Nothing urgent, just want to catch up properly
Yes — call me after 8 and I'll have the kitchen to myself
